newsitem.title: DUBAI: Kuwaiti crown prince leaves UAE.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti crown prince leaves UAE.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah left Abu Dhabi on Monday after calling on the United Arab Emirates' president, the official WAM news agency reported.
He arrived in Abu Dhabi earlier in the day to wish President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan well after recent surgery.
Sheikh Zaid, 78, returned home to a jubilant welcome on Wednesday after neck surgery in the United States.
